Author: Dalagab Group
Name: Omega
Punchline: A searchable marketplace for Dalamud plugins.
Description: Omega provides plugin discovery, Store-style rich/fallback listings, repository-aware install/uninstall lifecycle actions, Spotlight, Library, Updates, collections, searchable tags, API compatibility information, and one online-built SQLite catalog. Plugin lifecycle actions remain delegated to Dalamud. Security intelligence is generated by a separate daily static-analysis pipeline and displayed per scanned artifact.
